subject.title: fix(gateway): enforce plugin-ownership check in sessions.patch

question: Should legacy ownerless session rows remain permanently unavailable to plugin-runtime `sessions.patch` callers, while non-plugin operator clients retain access?
rationale: No stored owner safely identifies which plugin may adopt a legacy row, so this is a compatibility and product-policy choice rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Approve fail-closed ownership
options.body: Keep the proposed exact-owner rule and document that plugins cannot mutate legacy ownerless rows while operators can still manage them.

options.title: Require an explicit migration policy
options.body: Pause landing until maintainers define a safe migration or compatibility policy for legacy ownerless rows.

recommendation.title: Approve fail-closed ownership
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed exact-owner rule and document that plugins cannot mutate legacy ownerless rows while operators can still manage them.
